rules: Grade the answers object by exact JSON value and type for each required key.
A task passes only when every required answer is correct and its cited allowed-source evidence supports the answer.
Report correct fields separately from task pass/fail. Missing or null answers fail their field; they are not silently omitted.
Invalid source hashes, disallowed retrievals, reading grading material, shared task history or exceeded call limits invalidate the trial; retain it in the report with the reason.
Separate invalid trials, incorrect answers and infrastructure failures. Never substitute a successful retry for a failed original trial.
Remove treatment names before grading. Check source citations against the frozen files, not against the trial's own assertions.
Retain original answers. Provider usage and unverified text totals remain null. Do not infer calls avoided from absent full-file reads.
